method: Real Circle USDC payment (issued currency over a trustline, 0.001 USDC) to a second address we also control (XRPL forbids sender == destination, so no self-pay), timed submit -> validated ledger via xrpl-py submit_and_wait. A validated ledger is XRPL's true, deterministic finality (no reorgs, no soft-vs-hard split). Sent sequentially, one validated before the next (also required by the account Sequence number). USDC-parity run: same asset as the other rails (Circle USDC, issuer rGm7WCVp9gb4jZHWTEtGUr4dd74z2XuWhE).
